page.overview:
What is Damage Case?

Damage Case is the fourteenth track from Metallica's cover album Garage, Inc.. Disc 2.

Originally released by Motörhead in 1979 on the album Overkill, Metallica has already released their version in their 1996's Hero of the Day single.

Hey babe, don't act so scared All I want is some special care I'm on the run from some institution All I want's a little consolation

And I can tell by your face I'm a total disgrace Let me inside your place Move over for a damage case
